action: Start the timing and click the `-` box of the level `Platform`.
expectedResult: A loading spinner shows; when it ends only Platform rows are visible and the row count falls; the time from click to finished table is written down as A1.

action: Click the `+` box of the level `Platform`.
expectedResult: The spinner shows and ends; Platform rows with their Work Header rows are visible; the time is written down as A2.

action: Click the `+` box of the level `Work Header`.
expectedResult: The spinner shows and ends; Work Header rows with their Work rows are visible; the time is written down as A3.

action: Click the `+` box of the level `Work`.
expectedResult: The spinner shows and ends; Work rows with their Work Breakdown rows are visible; the time is written down as A4.

action: Click the `-` box of the level `Work Header`.
expectedResult: The spinner shows and ends; the Work rows are hidden; the time is written down as A5.

action: Click the `+` box of the level `Work Breakdown`.
expectedResult: The spinner shows and ends; the table shows the rows of all levels; the time is written down as A6.

action: Compare A1 to A6 with the limits.
expectedResult: Every time is 15 s or less (Pass), between 15 s and 20 s (Pass, the time is noted), or over 20 s (Fail).

action: Open the Custom View panel.
expectedResult: The section `Expand/Collapse by Data Level` shows Platform, Work Header, Work, Work Breakdown; the 4 boxes are written down as S0 (a box that looks lighter is described as "looks lighter").

action: Click the `-` box of `Platform`.
expectedResult: Only Platform rows are visible; the row count equals P; the box of `Platform` shows `+`.

action: Click the `+` box of `Platform`.
expectedResult: Platform and Work Header rows are visible; the row count equals P + H; the box of `Platform` shows `-`.

action: Click the `+` box of `Work Header`.
expectedResult: Platform, Work Header and Work rows are visible; the row count equals P + H + W.

action: Click the `+` box of `Work`.
expectedResult: All four levels are visible; the row count equals N0 and the row order equals step 1.

action: Click the `-` box of `Work`.
expectedResult: Work Breakdown rows are hidden; the row count equals P + H + W; the box of `Work` shows `+`.

action: Click the `-` box of `Work Header`.
expectedResult: Work rows are hidden; the row count equals P + H; the box of `Work Header` shows `+`.

action: Click the `+` box of `Work Breakdown`.
expectedResult: The row count equals N0 and the row order equals step 1.

action: Click the `-` box of the level `Work Header` in the Custom View panel.
expectedResult: Only rows that pass the filter are shown, collapsed to that level; no filtered-out row appears.

action: Click the `+` box of the level `Work Header`.
expectedResult: Platform, Work Header and Work rows of the filtered Platform are shown; Work Breakdown rows stay hidden (BA, 2026-11-24). The row count equals the Platform + Work Header + Work rows of F0; no filtered-out row appears.

action: Click the `-` box of the level `Work Header` in the Custom View panel.
expectedResult: Work rows disappear; Platform and Work Header rows stay.

action: Click the `+` box of the level `Work Header` within about 1 second.
expectedResult: The Work rows appear again.

action: Click the `-` box of the level `Work Header` within about 1 second.
expectedResult: The table ends collapsed to Platform and Work Header rows; no leftover Work rows and no error message.

action: Click the `+` box of the level `Work Header` once.
expectedResult: Platform, Work Header and Work rows are shown; Work Breakdown rows stay hidden (BA, 2026-11-24). The row order is the same as step 1 without the Work Breakdown rows, and the first Platform row is expanded.

action: Compare T1 to T4 with the limits.
expectedResult: Every time is 15 s or less (Pass), between 15 s and 20 s (Pass, the time is noted), or over 20 s (Fail).
